observations: All 57 native pages were viewed, covering the predefined rough/style/width/depth/partial/scene/extra/strength selection from 527 cases and 1180 computed conditions. Not all 1180 outputs were individually viewed.
Basic strokes, crossings, explicit gaps, blank and fills are retained. Rough stress41 has less fragmentation; taper tips are thinner.
Some regressions remain versus initial16200: tiny interior dots on stress38 base/faint/dark/sharp, roughness or thickening on soft12/24 and scene5.

Intermediate bar widths can produce double tracks or speckles (58-0.5, 60-0.5, 61-0.25, 62-0.25, 63-0.5). Large widths usually produce a centerline; short wide62-2.0 has the wrong/ambiguous orientation, though d3 is more continuous than d1.
No broad gray halos seen in generated areas; protected inputs intentionally retain gray.
EMA chosen for a mature preview, not a claim of universal improvement or solved sketch interpretation.
